name: pointer-capture-single-success
description: a down+capture+up pointer sequence dispatches through the gesture path and routes the mock driver's synthetic image into the run's screenshot artifacts
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pointer capture
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- pointer:
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down:
              x: 10
              y: 10
          - capture: mid-drag
          - up
